episodes.title: I Left  My Mom & The Church To Find My Spirituality
episodes.description:
What happens when the place that taught you about God becomes the place you no longer feel connected to your own spirit?
In this powerful conversation, Rob Sheely gets real about his decision to leave the church—and what he discovered on the other side.
Leaving wasn’t simply about walking away from a building, a denomination, or a religious community. It was about questioning what he had been taught, recognizing how deeply church culture had shaped his relationships and decisions, and learning to separate spirituality from organized religion.
Rob shares what it felt like to realize that some of the beliefs he once accepted without question were influencing who he trusted, who he spent time with, and even how he approached relationships.
And then came the harder question:
If I leave the church, what happens to my relationship with God?
This conversation explores the uncomfortable space between losing a religious identity and discovering a spiritual one that actually feels authentic.
IN THIS EPISODE
• Why Rob decided to leave the church • What happened when church leadership began influencing his personal relationships • How religious beliefs can shape the way we see ourselves and others • The difference between religion and spirituality • What happens when you begin questioning what you've always been taught • Finding your own spiritual path after leaving organized religion • Learning to trust your own instincts again • Why leaving doesn't necessarily mean losing your faith • What Rob discovered about himself after walking away
This isn't about telling you what to believe.
It's about having the courage to ask what you actually believe.
Because sometimes finding your spirituality requires you to first walk away from everything you thought spirituality was supposed to look like.
You heard the story. Now let's talk about what to DO with it.
If you've ever questioned your relationship with church, religion, spirituality, or the beliefs you inherited, this conversation is for you.
KEEPING IT REAL ON PURPOSE
Real stories. Real conversations. Real growth.
Subscribe for more conversations about lived experience, healing, identity, purpose, and what happens next.

episodes.title: I Didn't Join a Cult. I Joined a Church.
episodes.description: For 28 years, I believed I was serving the Divine. I followed the rules, silenced my questions, and ignored the quiet voice inside me that kept whispering something wasn't right. This isn't a story about attacking faith. It's a story about what happens when control is mistaken for spirituality and fear replaces freedom. In this deeply personal episode of Unchurched, I share the journey I never thought I would tell publicly—the emotional, psychological, and spiritual wounds that kept me trapped for nearly three decades. You'll hear the moments that broke me, the questions that changed everything, and how I found my way back to the God within me instead of the fear that had defined my relationship with religion. If you've ever felt guilty for asking questions, afraid to leave, or wondered whether your faith belonged to you or to someone else, this conversation may help you realize you're not losing your faith—you may finally be finding it. This isn't about leaving God. It's about leaving what stood between you and the Divine. Subscribe to Unchurched: Where Truth Breaks Tradition and join the conversation as we explore religious trauma, spiritual healing, and the courage to reclaim your own voice.

episodes.title: Church Hurt Changed Everything | Religious Trauma, Spiritual Abuse & Finding Freedom
episodes.description: Have you ever questioned your faith because of church hurt? Have you experienced spiritual abuse, religious manipulation, or been used by the very people you trusted? In this episode of Unchurched, Edna White sits down with Stephanie C. Jones, who shares her powerful journey of surviving religious trauma and reclaiming her identity after years of serving in ministry. Raised in the church, Stephanie faithfully served as a youth pastor, Sunday School superintendent, and worship leader. But behind the scenes, her gifts were exploited, her voice was overlooked, and she eventually found herself discarded by the very community she had devoted her life to. Today, Stephanie helps others heal from toxic church experiences by embracing wholeness, wellness, and authentic faith without manipulation or control. If you've struggled with church hurt, faith deconstruction, religious abuse, toxic leadership, or are searching for healing after leaving the church, this conversation will remind you that your story isn't over. In this episode you'll discover: • The warning signs of spiritual abuse and toxic church culture • How religious trauma impacts your identity and relationships • The difference between faith and religious control • Practical steps toward healing and emotional freedom • Why walking away from abuse doesn't mean walking away from God Subscribe to Unchurched for honest conversations about church hurt, spiritual healing, faith, and living free from religious manipulation. If this conversation resonated with you, don't let your healing stop here. Church hurt, spiritual abuse, and religious trauma don't have to define the rest of your life.
